title: The empty list is a left identity for append
statement: For any type and any list as, appending as to the empty list gives as.

formal.statement: ((α : Sort (u+1)) -> ((as : List.{u} α) -> Eq.{u+1} (List.{u} α) (HAppend.hAppend.{u, u, u} (List.{u} α) (List.{u} α) (List.{u} α) (instHAppendOfAppend.{u} (List.{u} α) (List.instAppend.{u} α)) (List.nil.{u} α) as) as))
